These queries come from the documentation page alone; I have not run any of them.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(lower | endsWith "@example.com"))) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | if (eq null) ~("unknown") ~(at :country | coalesce "unknown") | keyword) * count
T4: /data/users | filter ~(at :profile | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(at :age | ne null)) | * /profile/age | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") (at :assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login | keyword) * count
T8: unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | keyword) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2 | keyword) * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | flat | * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 1) | * (split "," | {:q (/3 | parseJson) :p /4 :s (/5 | lower)}) | filter ~(allOf (/s | eq "shipped") (/p | ne "")) | * ([/q (/p | parseJson)] | reduce 1 ~(mul)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 1) | * (split "," | {:c /1 :q (/3 | parseJson) :p /4 :s (/5 | lower)}) | filter ~(allOf (/s | ne "cancelled") (/p | ne "")) | * {:c /c :t ([/q (/p | parseJson)] | reduce 1 ~(mul))} | groupBy ~(/c | keyword) * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
